import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
credit_fraud = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Plot the distribution of transaction amounts
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.distplot(credit_fraud['amount'], kde=True, color='blue')
plt.title('Distribution of Transaction Amounts')
plt.xlabel('Amount ($)')
plt.ylabel('Frequency')
plt.savefig('output_amount_dist.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Plot the frequency of transaction types
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.countplot(x='transaction_type', data=credit_fraud, color='blue')
plt.title('Frequency of Transaction Types')
plt.xlabel('Transaction Type')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.savefig('output_transaction_type.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Plot the distribution of hours of day for fraudulent transactions
fraudulent = credit_fraud[credit_fraud['is_fraud'] == 1]
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.distplot(fraudulent['hour_of_day'], kde=True, color='blue')
plt.title('Distribution of Hours of Day for Fraudulent Transactions')
plt.xlabel('Hour of Day')
plt.ylabel('Frequency')
plt.savefig('output_fraud_hour.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Plot the distribution of hours of day for non-fraudulent transactions
non_fraudulent = credit_fraud[credit_fraud['is_fraud'] == 0]
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.distplot(non_fraudulent['hour_of_day'], kde=True, color='blue')
plt.title('Distribution of Hours of Day for Non-Fraudulent Transactions')
plt.xlabel('Hour of Day')
plt.ylabel('Frequency')
plt.savefig('output_non_fraud_hour.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Plot the amount vs hour of day for all transactions
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.scatterplot(x='hour_of_day', y='amount', data=credit_fraud, hue='is_fraud', palette=['blue', 'red'])
plt.title('Amount vs Hour of Day for All Transactions')
plt.xlabel('Hour of Day')
plt.ylabel('Amount ($)')
plt.legend(title='Fraudulent')
plt.savefig('output_amount_hour.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
credit_fraud = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Plot the distribution of transaction amounts
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.distplot(credit_fraud['amount'], kde=True, color='blue')

plt.xlabel('Amount ($)')
plt.ylabel('Frequency')
plt.savefig('output_amount_dist.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Plot the frequency of transaction types
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.countplot(x='transaction_type', data=credit_fraud, color='blue')
plt.title('Frequency of Transaction Types')
plt.xlabel('Transaction Type')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.savefig('output_transaction_type.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Plot the distribution of hours of day for fraudulent transactions
fraudulent = credit_fraud[credit_fraud['is_fraud'] == 1]
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.distplot(fraudulent['hour_of_day'], kde=True, color='blue')
plt.title('Distribution of Hours of Day for Fraudulent Transactions')
plt.xlabel('Hour of Day')
plt.ylabel('Frequency')
plt.savefig('output_fraud_hour.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Plot the distribution of hours of day for non-fraudulent transactions
non_fraudulent = credit_fraud[credit_fraud['is_fraud'] == 0]
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.distplot(non_fraudulent['hour_of_day'], kde=True, color='blue')
plt.title('Distribution of Hours of Day for Non-Fraudulent Transactions')
plt.xlabel('Hour of Day')
plt.ylabel('Frequency')
plt.savefig('output_non_fraud_hour.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Plot the amount vs hour of day for all transactions
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.scatterplot(x='hour_of_day', y='amount', data=credit_fraud, hue='is_fraud', palette=['blue', 'red'])
plt.title('Amount vs Hour of Day for All Transactions')
plt.xlabel('Hour of Day')
plt.ylabel('Amount ($)')
plt.legend(title='Fraudulent')
plt.savefig('output_amount_hour.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
